title: Additional terms under § 2-207(2)
summary: Additional terms are proposals; between merchants they may enter unless a statutory exception applies.
notes: The text identifies three exceptions: an offer expressly limiting acceptance, material alteration, and timely notification of objection. Bayway concerns the material-alteration exception and puts its proof on the opponent of inclusion. Nonmerchant transactions do not receive the same automatic incorporation rule, as Klocek emphasizes. Materiality must be assessed under the governing legal approach rather than reduced to the size of a payment.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 284–290. Open assigned page 284.
